svg.desc: consonant-ending words, including अस्, अन्, अन्त्, | मत्, वत् classes | Relation: प्रथमा–द्वितीया–संबोधन द्विवचनम् | वैदिक: -आ commonly replaces laukika -औ | लौकिक: -औ | Contribution: open · Evidence: form recorded · question open | Prevalence: 85.7% (6/7 tokens) · grade B
